fusions.name: Loose Cobbles
fusions.desc: Throws 3 stones in a spread out to 6 tiles, each dealing 2 damage.

fusions.name: Knapped Flint
fusions.desc: Cuts with a flake of knapped flint for 7 damage, leaving the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Dry-Stone Course
fusions.desc: Stacks a stone wall 5 tiles long across the ground for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Hod Carrier
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you have 8% earth resistance.
